item.title: Orbot v1.14.0
item.description:
Orbot 1.14.0 | Orbot
- Updated Tor to 0.4.9.14 and OpenSSL to 3.6.5. - Updated Snowflake to 2.15.1. - Updated Lyrebird to version 0.9.0. - Fixed crashes that occurred seemingly at random.
**ATTENTION**: The attached binaries **do not work** without resigning them. Insofar, they're here mostly for documentary purposes. (Unfortunately, there currently seems to be no way to resign VPN apps. If you find one, please get in touch!)
